verdict.rationale: Audience segmentation is a fair question for a Segment-alternative CDP, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no natural-language segment builder. The MCP server lets external agents manage pipeline objects (destinations, streams, Live Events, Functions), and Profile Builder generates profiles from traits or JavaScript. Neither is AI building an audience or segment definition from a description grounded in the user's schema; at most they are adjacent building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema
